raw_block.rationale: Create one grounded joint package: §152(a)(1) first derives dependent status from the expressly given qualifying-child intermediate; §152(b)(1) then consumes that legal predicate and compares the relevant calendar years. A separate §151(c) terminal skill reads the dependent status expressly given in that case instead of recomputing it. This targets the failed §152(b)(1) parent while preserving the successful §151(c) parent.

skill.intent: Determine whether an individual is a dependent under §152(a)(1) when the current facts expressly give qualifying-child status under §152(c)(1).

inputs.name: is_expressly_qualifying_child_under_152_c_1
inputs.question: Do the current case facts expressly state that the individual satisfies §152(c)(1) as the taxpayer's qualifying child for the relevant year?

outputs.name: is_dependent_under_152
outputs.description: Whether the individual is a dependent of the taxpayer under §152(a)(1).

premises.name: qualifying_child_counts_as_dependent
premises.question: Does §152(a)(1) include a qualifying child within the definition of dependent?

origin.quote: For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means— (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

reads.question: Identify whether the current facts expressly give the individual's qualifying-child status under §152(c)(1).

fields.name: is_expressly_qualifying_child_under_152_c_1
fields.question: Do the facts expressly state that the individual satisfies §152(c)(1) as the taxpayer's qualifying child?

source_obligations.statement: Treat an expressly established qualifying child as a dependent under §152(a)(1).

origin.quote: the term "dependent" means— (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

source_provenance.quote: For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means— (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

skill.intent: Answer a positive or negative claim that §152(b)(1) applies to an individual who is a dependent of another taxpayer, accounting for the same-calendar-year condition.
skill.procedure:
rule_applies = bool(inputs["is_dependent_under_152"] and inputs["taxpayer_taxable_year_begin_calendar_year"] == inputs["individual_taxable_year_begin_calendar_year"] and premises["dependent_has_no_dependents_same_calendar_year"])
claim_matches = rule_applies == inputs["question_claims_section_152_b_1_applies"]
answer = "Entailment" if claim_matches else "Contradiction"
return {"answer": answer}

inputs.name: is_dependent_under_152
inputs.question: Is the individual a dependent of another taxpayer under §152 for the relevant taxpayer year?

inputs.name: taxpayer_taxable_year_begin_calendar_year
inputs.question: In what calendar year does the other taxpayer's relevant taxable year begin?

inputs.name: individual_taxable_year_begin_calendar_year
inputs.question: In what calendar year does the individual's queried taxable year begin?

inputs.name: question_claims_section_152_b_1_applies
inputs.question: Does the current question assert, rather than deny, that §152(b)(1) applies to the individual?

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The native Entailment or Contradiction label for the §152(b)(1) applicability claim.

premises.name: dependent_has_no_dependents_same_calendar_year
premises.question: Does §152(b)(1) treat a dependent as having no dependents for the dependent's taxable year beginning in the same calendar year?

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

reads.question: Read the two relevant calendar years and the literal polarity of the current §152(b)(1) claim.

fields.name: taxpayer_taxable_year_begin_calendar_year
fields.question: What calendar year is identified for the taxpayer year in which the individual is a dependent?

fields.name: individual_taxable_year_begin_calendar_year
fields.question: What calendar year is identified for the individual's queried year?

fields.name: question_claims_section_152_b_1_applies
fields.question: Does the question literally assert that §152(b)(1) applies?

source_obligations.statement: Apply the §152(b)(1) restriction only when the individual is a dependent of a taxpayer.

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year

source_obligations.statement: Require the individual's taxable year to begin in the same calendar year as the taxpayer year establishing dependency.

source_provenance.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

skill.intent: Answer whether §151(c) allows a taxpayer an exemption for an individual whose dependent status under §152 is expressly given in the current facts.
skill.procedure:
exemption_allowed = bool(inputs["individual_is_dependent_under_152"] and premises["section_151c_allows_exemption_for_dependent"])
claim_matches = exemption_allowed == inputs["question_claims_exemption_allowed_under_151_c"]
answer = "Entailment" if claim_matches else "Contradiction"
return {"answer": answer}

inputs.name: individual_is_dependent_under_152
inputs.question: Do the current facts expressly state that the individual is the taxpayer's dependent under §152 for the relevant taxable year?

inputs.name: question_claims_exemption_allowed_under_151_c
inputs.question: Does the current question assert, rather than deny, that the taxpayer may claim the dependent exemption under §151(c)?

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The native Entailment or Contradiction label for the §151(c) dependent-exemption claim.

premises.name: section_151c_allows_exemption_for_dependent
premises.question: Does §151(c) provide an exemption amount for each individual who is the taxpayer's dependent under §152?
